description.p: An unofficial, third-party desktop client for FMHY (FreeMediaHeckYeah). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of FMHY. All indexed content belongs to the FMHY project and its contributors.

The whole wiki is available offline-first, with full-text search across every entry, favourites, browsing history and downloads. External links open in an embedded browser built on the system's own web engine, so no second browser engine is shipped.

ul.li: Full-text search over the entire FMHY index
Content blocking using the same filter lists uBlock Origin reads
In-page protection against popups, popunders and interstitials
Private browsing that keeps nothing on disk
Favourites, history and a downloads list
